question.problem:
Suppose $X$ and $Y$ are discrete random variables. Let the joint CDF of $X$ and $Y$ be $F(x,y),$ where

$$
F(9,10)=0.65,\,F(6,10)=0.31,\,F(3,10)=0.12,
$$

and the supports of $X$ and $Y$, respectively, are

$$
{S}_{X}=\{3,6,9,12\},\,{S}_{Y}=\{2,4,6,8,10,12\}.
$$

Find $P(3<X\le 9,Y\le 10).$
question.worked_solution:
Note the following:

- For a given joint PMF $f(x,y),$ we can think of each point where $f(x,y)\ne 0$ as a point mass in the plane, where the "probability mass" at each point equals the probability associated with that point.

- The joint CDF $F(x,y)=P(X\le x,Y\le y)$ is the total "probability mass" that lies in the infinite rectangular region that has its top-right corner at $(x,y)$ and whose sides are parallel to the coordinate axis.

Given the supports of $X$ and $Y,$ the joint support $S$ is a subset of

$$
{S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y}=\{3,6,9,12\}\times \{2,4,6,8,10,12\}.
$$

Let's sketch the points in ${S}_{X}\times {S}_{Y},$ which contains the joint support.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14177883/assets/7790a013e37bb86c00b44b1c022d6597f9bbdd57616c48e7ee7dfe8ddf512c63.png)

Let's sketch the region corresponding to the probability we wish to find.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14177883/assets/379f0690fdbe92b7fb8f66cce4f12b214a23c6299fb8df71edf56d37fc0387fe.png)

Geometrically, this region can be obtained by taking all points in the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(9,10)$ (the blue region below) and *subtracting* all points in the infinite rectangle that has its top-right corner at $(3,10)$ (the red region below).

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/foundations/14177883/assets/90a6730747b59a9886acbdf21880ca6a7ec3266142522ea5b32f07090963a98d.png)

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(3<X\le 9,Y\le 10) & =\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(9,10)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 9,Y\le 10)}}-\overset{\text{top-right corner at }(3,10)}{\overset{⏞}{P(X\le 3,Y\le 10)}} \\  & =F(9,10)-F(3,10) \\  & =0.65-0.12 \\  & =0.53.\end{aligned}
$$
